evidence.excerpt: Aleksandar Bošković received his Dipl.Ing. degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Novi Sad in 2004 and his PhD from the same institution in 2011, with a thesis on residual stress formation in injection-moulded semi-crystalline thermoplastics. He was appointed Assistant Professor in 2012 and promoted to Associate Professor in 2018 within the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Faculty of Technical Sciences. His research group focuses on coupled thermomechanical simulation of polymer processing, particularly predicting warpage, residual stresses, and optimising mould cooling systems for semi-crystalline materials such as polyamide and polypropylene. He teaches courses in Machine Elements and Polymer Processing Technology. The group works primarily with commercial FEA and injection moulding simulation packages, and has access to a materials testing laboratory with DSC, tensile testing frames, and coordinate measuring equipment for warpage validation.
